name: application-qr-code-card
title: QR Code Card
description: Card presenting a generated QR code with a caption, the encoded value as visible text, and Download/Copy link actions.
useWhen: Sharing an invite link, event check-in, or Wi-Fi credential as a scannable QR code alongside its plain-text value.
You want consistent Download/Copy actions around any QR code your app generates.
Distinct from the small QR used inside Two-Factor Setup — this card treats the QR as the primary content, not one step of a larger flow.
avoidWhen: The QR code is only a minor decorative element next to other primary content — embed a bare QR image instead of the full card.
You need a live-scanning camera view — this component only displays a generated code, it doesn't scan one.
responsiveBehavior: The card and its fixed-size QR tile stay centered at a constant size; on very narrow viewports the caption and value text wrap or truncate rather than shrinking the QR itself illegibly small.
accessibility: The QR image has role="img" with an aria-label stating the destination, since the pattern itself conveys nothing to assistive technology.
The encoded value is always shown as selectable, readable text below the code, giving a non-visual, non-camera fallback.
The QR always renders on a white background tile regardless of theme, preserving the contrast ratio real QR scanners require.

variants.title: QR Code Card
variants.description: A 'Scan to join workspace' card with a generated QR code, the invite URL shown below it, and Download / Copy link actions.
accessibility: The `qrCode` prop accepts a real QR-rendering component; the built-in placeholder pattern is purely illustrative for previewing layout.

variants.title: QR Code Card (Dark)
variants.description: The same QR card adapted for dark surfaces; the QR tile itself stays white for scannability.
accessibility: Card chrome and text adopt dark styling, but the QR module never inverts, since real-world scanners expect dark-on-light contrast.
